set(QAK_AEC_EXECUTABLE "$<TARGET_FILE:qak_aec>")
include("${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../src/QActionKitMacros.cmake")

macro(qak_add_example _target)
    set(CMAKE_AUTOMOC ON)
    set(CMAKE_AUTOUIC ON)
    set(CMAKE_AUTORCC ON)

    add_executable(${_target})
    qm_configure_target(${_target} ${ARGN})

    # The headers generated by qak_add_action_extension() are in the current binary directory.
    target_include_directories(${_target} PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR})
endmacro()

# Each example requires the module that it demonstrates.
if(QACTIONKIT_BUILD_WIDGETS)
    add_subdirectory(mainwindow)
endif()
if(QACTIONKIT_BUILD_QUICK)
    add_subdirectory(quick)
endif()
